blocks.text: Statistical modeling data se duniya ko samajhne aur future (aane wale waqt) mein kya hoga, is ka andaza lagane ka tareeqa hai. Aise sochein: agar aap jaanna chahte hain ke agle mahine grocery par kitne paise lagenge, to aap pichhle kharche dekhenge. Us data ko analyze kar ke (jaanch kar) aap ek model bana sakte hain jo aane wale grocery kharche ka andaza lagaye.

Misal: Agar aap aam taur par har mahine taqreeban 10,000 rupay kharch karte hain lekin kharcha upar neeche hota rehta hai, to statistical model family size (ghar ke logon ki ginti) ya special occasions (khaas mauqe, jaise Eid ya shaadi) jaise factors (wajahein jo kharche par asar dalti hain) bhi shamil kar sakta hai. Is tarah agle mahine ke grocery budget ka behtar andaza lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: Grocery ke model mein kaunse factors (asar dalne wali cheezein) shamil ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Pichhla kharcha, family size, location (jagah), income (aamdani) aur khaas mauqe.

items: Statistical modeling: purane data se seekh kar prediction (maslan agle mahine ka grocery bill).
